{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
df_mean = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
df_mean = df_mean.sort_values('flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Print the mean flipper length by species
print(df_mean)

# Extract and print the species with the highest mean
highest_species = df_mean.iloc[0]['species']
print(highest_species)"}
